chunks: And with this chain of narration, he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said:
We are the People of the House, for whom charity is not permissible, and we have been commanded to perfect the ablution; and that we should not force a donkey onto a fine horse.

key_terms.نَنزِي: We force/mate (specifically in the context of animal breeding)

ai.seo_question: What are the specific rulings regarding charity and breeding for the Ahl al-Bayt according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* underscores the unique status of the Ahl al-Bayt as recipients of both *sadaqah* (general charity) and *zakat* (obligatory alms), distinguishing them from other Muslims. The command to 'perfect the purification' (*isbah al-tahur*) is often interpreted by Shia scholars as a reference to their spiritual and physical purity (*Ismah*), while the specific instruction on breeding highlights the Prophet's attention to practical details of daily life and lineage preservation.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-32 According to the same documentation, God’s Prophet (S) said, “

We - Members of the Holy Household - cannot accept charity. We are instructed to perform the ablutions with the full obligatory and recommendable procedures. We are also instructed not to force a good horse to copulate with a donkey.”
